item.title: Folk Alley Radio Show #260226 - Folk Alley
item.description: This week on Folk Alley, as Black History Month winds down and we look ahead to Women’s History Month in March, we celebrate the contributions of amazing Black women of folk, roots, and Americana – both historical and contemporary. Hear music from Bessie Jones, Odetta, Etta Baker, Joan Armatrading, Tracy Chapman, Allison Russell, Sunny War, Yasmin Williams, Valerie June, Miko Marks, and more.

item.title: Folk Alley Radio Show #260305 - Folk Alley
item.description: This week on Folk Alley, in honor of Women’s History Month, we celebrate legendary and iconic women of folk, country, and roots music whose voices have shaped the sound and spirit of these genres—and continue to inspire artists today. Hear from trailblazers like Joan Baez, Joni Mitchell, Odetta, Mavis Staples, Emmylou Harris, Dolly Parton, Hazel Dickens & Alice Gerrard, Maddy Prior, Sandy Denny, and many more extraordinary women whose influence remains indelible.

item.title: Basic Folk podcast, eps. 338 - Joe Henry & Mark Erelli - Folk Alley
item.description: Mark Erelli & Joe Henry were looking for an excuse to hang out, so we decided to get them together for a joint interview. It's cool how many parallels we found between the two of them: Maine, waking up early, being friends with nice guys, living with chronic illness, being free of their own vanity. Mark's new record is out now and Joe released an album in the fall (2025) with Mike Reid. item.title: Folk Alley Radio Show #260312 - Folk Alley
item.description: This week on Folk Alley—in honor of Women's History Month and St. Patricks's Day—join host Cindy Howes for celebration of Irish & Irish-American women in folk music. Hear from Mary Black, Dolores Keane, Mairéad Ní Mhaonaigh, Cathy Jordan, Moya Brennan, Karan Casey, Sharon Shannon, Niamh Parsons, and so much more!

item.title: Basic Folk podcast, eps. 339 - The Mammals - Folk Alley
item.description: Mike and Ruth Merenda have been making music together as The Mammals since 2001, with a little break in 2008 to play as Mike & Ruthy. They've been back as The Mammals since 2017 with a couple of great albums. We dig into a few of the songs on their new double album 'Touch Grass.' There are A LOT to choose from: seventeen tracks in all.

item.title: Hear the Best New Folk Music with Fresh Cuts Friday - Folk Alley
item.description: It's #NewMusicFriday! Check out this week's newest folk music! We’ve got a little taste of all of it, as always, thanks to host Cindy Howes and her Fresh Cuts radio hour. You can tune into Folk Alley on the website, app, or via your smart speaker at 2 p.m. Eastern, 11 a.m. Pacific, or just click on the Fresh Cuts stream whenever it’s convenient for you.

item.title: Folk Alley Radio Show #260319 - Folk Alley
item.description: This week on Folk Alley—we wrap up our Women's History Month celebration by sharing songs by many of our favorite contemporary women artists in folk, roots, and Americana. Hear from Brandi Carlile, Molly Tuttle, Anais Mitchell, Rose Cousins, Rhiannon Giddens, Allison Russell, Aoife O'Donovan, Kacey Musgraves, and so much more.
